build_panoptic_fpn_model: build a PanopticFPN model from config using from_config to initialize semantic segmentation head and ROI heads
run_panoptic_fpn_forward: run the PanopticFPN forward pass on batched inputs to compute instance and semantic segmentation losses
run_panoptic_fpn_inference: run PanopticFPN inference on batched inputs to produce panoptic segmentation with postprocessing enabled
combine_semantic_and_instance_outputs: combine semantic segmentation results and instance detection outputs into a unified panoptic segmentation map
review_panoptic_fpn_combine_logic: review the combine_semantic_and_instance_outputs function logic for overlap threshold and stuff area filtering
